$notes.about: Chase and first-person framing. Distances in metres, FOV in degrees, follow rates in 1/s.
$notes.pitchShare: the chase camera follows this share of the hero's pitch, keeping the horizon readable
$notes.turnLead: seconds of yaw rate the camera looks ahead into a turn
$notes.rollShare: share of the hero's bank the chase camera rolls with (first person uses the player's comfort setting)
$notes.firstPersonPitchShare: first person looks where you fly: this share of the hero's pitch
$notes.freeLook: hold to look around without changing course: max yaw / pitch (rad), response (1/s) while held, returnTime (s) to spring back when released
